title: Distance moved this frame
prompt: delta is how many seconds the last frame took. Return how far something moving at speed pixels per second travels during that frame.
signature: func solve(speed: float, delta: float) -> float:
starter:
func solve(speed: float, delta: float) -> float:
	return speed
hint: Pixels per second times seconds gives pixels.
solution:
func solve(speed: float, delta: float) -> float:
	return speed * delta
